mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and other hepatic enzymes, reducing diclofenac plasma concentrations; additionally, NSAIDs may increase seizure risk and diclofenac can inhibit renal clearance affecting eslicarbazepine metabolism.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of diclofenac and seizure control; consider alternative analgesics with lower enzyme induction interaction potential or dose adjustment; counsel on increased seizure risk and GI bleeding.
